claims.quote: Krabbe disease (KD), also known as globoid cell leukodystrophy, is a rare autosomal recessive neurodegenerative disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the GALC gene.
Generalized tonic-clonic seizures as the initial symptom of late-onset Krabbe disease: a Case Report.
While infantile-onset KD is prevalent globally, adult-onset KD is frequently presented in East Asian populations and typically manifests with progressive spastic paraparesis.
Brain MRI revealed symmetrical white matter lesions and early cortical involvement.
